response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with staff-level titles, strong full-stack and distributed-systems credentials, and recent exposure to MCP code generators and agentic developer tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years of shipping production-grade AI/GenAI solutions, and his AI experience appears to be roughly one year of adjacent infrastructure work rather than building AI systems. The resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/optimization, multi-agent frameworks, data pipelines for unstructured data, or Python — and cloud experience is limited to AWS CDK on a pricing platform. Strong engineering fundamentals and customer-facing mentoring/teaching history make him a plausible candidate for a general staff engineering role, but he is a weak match for this GenAI-specialist profile.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience with staff-level scope and strong TypeScript/Node.js depth
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience at re:cinq, directly relevant to a listed key technology
Proven mentoring, workshop delivery, and public speaking — fits the customer-facing technical-leadership aspect
concerns: Lacks the required 8+ years building production AI solutions; AI exposure appears to be ~1 year and infrastructure-adjacent
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent framework experience
Python absent from skills; cloud experience is thin (AWS CDK only) with no AI systems built on a major cloud platform

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG / vector DB / agent framework skills
Senior generalist engineering and MCP/agent tooling exposure
